description: This file defines the WebApplication class, a core component that manages the web application's initialization, event handling, services, and lifecycle methods within a larger software project. It includes imports of various modules, manages application states, event observers, services, and platform-specific functionality.

classes.name: WebApplication
classes.description: Represents the main web application class responsible for managing application lifecycle, services, event observers, and platform-specific behaviors within the larger codebase. It extends SNApplication and implements WebApplicationInterface, encapsulating core functionalities for the web app environment.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Performs deinitialization of the application, cleaning up services, observers, and resetting relevant properties.

methods.name: addWebEventObserver
methods.description: Registers a new web event observer callback and returns a function to remove it.

methods.name: notifyWebEvent
methods.description: Invokes all registered web event observers with the specified event and optional data.

methods.name: publishPanelDidResizeEvent
methods.description: Publishes a panel resize event with panel name, width, and collapsed state.

methods.name: getViewControllerManager
methods.description: Returns the current instance of the ViewControllerManager.

methods.name: getDesktopService
methods.description: Returns the DesktopManager service if available.

methods.name: getAutolockService
methods.description: Returns the AutolockService instance.

methods.name: getArchiveService
methods.description: Returns the ArchiveManager instance.

methods.name: get paneController
methods.description: Returns the pane controller from the viewControllerManager.

methods.name: get linkingController
methods.description: Returns the linking controller from the viewControllerManager.

methods.name: get changelogService
methods.description: Returns the changelog service instance.

methods.name: get momentsService
methods.description: Returns the MomentsService instance.

methods.name: get featuresController
methods.description: Returns the features controller from the viewControllerManager.

methods.name: isNativeIOS
methods.description: Determines if the app is running natively on iOS.

methods.name: get isMobileDevice
methods.description: Checks if the device is a mobile device.

methods.name: hideOutboundSubscriptionLinks
methods.description: Returns true if outbound subscription links should be hidden (e.g., on iOS).

methods.name: mobileDevice
methods.description: Returns the mobile device interface, throws error if accessed on non-mobile platform.

methods.name: getThemeService
methods.description: Retrieves the current theme service.

methods.name: get keyboardService
methods.description: Retrieves the keyboard service.

methods.name: checkForSecurityUpdate
methods.description: Async method to check if security protocol upgrade is available.

methods.name: downloadBackup
methods.description: Initiates download of backup if on desktop device.

methods.name: signOutAndDeleteLocalBackups
methods.description: Signs out the user and deletes local backups asynchronously.

methods.name: isGlobalSpellcheckEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether global spellcheck is enabled.

methods.name: getItemTags
methods.description: Retrieves tags referencing the given item.

methods.name: get version
methods.description: Returns the application version string.

methods.name: toggleGlobalSpellcheck
methods.description: Toggles the global spellcheck setting asynchronously.

methods.name: handleMobileEnteringBackgroundEvent
methods.description: Handles mobile app entering background event.

methods.name: handleMobileGainingFocusEvent
methods.description: Handles mobile app gaining focus event.

methods.name: handleMobileLosingFocusEvent
methods.description: Handles mobile app losing focus event, including locking if needed.

methods.name: handleMobileResumingFromBackgroundEvent
methods.description: Handles app resuming from background, e.g., hiding screenshots.

methods.name: handleMobileColorSchemeChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles change in mobile device color scheme.

methods.name: handleMobileKeyboardWillChangeFrameEvent
methods.description: Handles event when mobile keyboard frame is about to change; adjusts viewport height.

methods.name: handleMobileKeyboardDidChangeFrameEvent
methods.description: Handles event after mobile keyboard frame has changed.

methods.name: handleAndroidU2FAuthenticatorResponse
methods.description: Handles response from Android U2F authenticator.

methods.name: lockApplicationAfterMobileEventIfApplicable
methods.description: Locks the application if privacy/security conditions are met after mobile events.

methods.name: handleAndroidBackButtonPressed
methods.description: Handles Android back button presses.

methods.name: addAndroidBackHandlerEventListener
methods.description: Adds event listener for Android back button events.

methods.name: setAndroidBackHandlerFallbackListener
methods.description: Sets fallback listener for Android back button.

methods.name: isAuthorizedToRenderItem
methods.description: Checks if the current user/event context is authorized to render a specific item.

methods.name: entitledToPerTagPreferences
methods.description: Determines if the user is entitled to per-tag preferences based on subscription.

methods.name: get entitledToFiles
methods.description: Returns true if user has access to files.

methods.name: showPremiumModal
methods.description: Displays premium subscription modal with optional feature name.

methods.name: hasValidSubscription
methods.description: Checks if the user has a valid subscription.

methods.name: openPurchaseFlow
methods.description: Opens the purchase flow UI.

methods.name: addNativeMobileEventListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for native mobile events.

methods.name: showAccountMenu
methods.description: Shows the account menu.

methods.name: hideAccountMenu
methods.description: Hides the account menu.

methods.name: isFullU2FClient
methods.description: Indicates whether the current environment supports full U2F client capabilities.

methods.name: geDefaultEditorIdentifier
methods.description: Gets the default editor identifier, considering current tags and preferences.

methods.name: openPreferences
methods.description: Opens the preferences UI, optionally focusing on a specific pane.

methods.name: generateUUID
methods.description: Generates a new UUID string.

ctags.name: WebApplication
ctags.pattern: /^export class WebApplication extends SNApplication implements WebApplicationInterface {$/

ctags.name: WebEventObserver
ctags.pattern: /^export type WebEventObserver = (event: WebAppEvent, data?: unknown) => void$/
